matches.rationale: No report finding says the minimum deposit leaves out the 128-byte account storage overhead in the rent calculation.

Finding 2 identifies that the user-supplied bump is stored for the deposit receipt instead of ctx.bumps. Finding 11 makes the same point for withdraw, but each reference can match only one report finding.
Finding 9 only says the chainId parameter is unused. It does not say that emitting the Ethereum chain id as the destination is wrong when messages go to Eclipse.
No report finding mentions log truncation.
Finding 1 is about nonces being predictable. It does not cover 64-bit collision risk or the missing reuse check on sendNonces.
Finding 6 is about unbounded loops, not about an empty array passing validation.
Finding 12 is about the relayer's control over message passing, not about the relayer key holding custody of bridged funds.
No report finding mentions the missing _disableInitializers call.
No report finding mentions invoke_signed being used where invoke would do.
Finding 20 identifies the oversized 1024-byte Configuration allocation when about 11 bytes are needed.
